subject: Hosted API — token bucket estimate & peak TPS follow-up
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@atlashealth.ai>, Ava Chen <ava@atlashealth.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API — token bucket estimate & peak TPS follow-up

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the action items we discussed related to hosted API pricing qualification: 

Summary / asks: 
- Monthly token volumes: you mentioned a baseline of "~300M to 500M tokens/month" for core user flows, with experimental ML features that could add additional bursts. Please confirm a conservative expected volume for Q3.
- Peak TPS: you reported 120 TPS sustained during a 10-minute internal test and a ~350 TPS spike for a 90-second sync backfill. We need a realistic peak TPS target you want covered for SLA/burst design (e.g., 150 TPS, 300 TPS, 500 TPS).
- Budget target: your finance note said target ~ $1.2k - $1.8k per 1M tokens net (post-discounts) for initial contract sizing — confirm if that is still the internal expectation.

Attachments: you shared a sample of aggregated traffic during the pilot (atlas_sample_traffic_agg.csv) — thanks, that helped. I'm attaching a quick pricing scenario workbook (redwood_pricing_scenario_v2.xlsx) with three simple unit-econ models keyed to monthly tokens and peak TPS.

Next steps: 
1) Samuel: please confirm a conservative monthly tokens estimate (single number) and the peak TPS you want included in the reserved-capacity discussion. If you have an expected 99th-percentile TPS number from monitoring, that helps.
2) Karthik + Marissa: we'll prepare an initial hosted pricing quote and a recommended burst policy (reserve + burst) once we get the numbers.
3) Procurement: if you want our commercial checklist (billing PO cadence / SOC2 items) we can share it.

If it's helpful, I'm free Monday morning to jump on a 20-min call to walk through the workbook line-by-line.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@atlashealth.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API — token bucket estimate & peak TPS follow-up

Neha — thanks for the recap and the workbook. A few clarifyers from our side: 

- For Q3 conservative planning let's use 420000000 tokens/month (420M). That is what product metrics point to after feature gating the new summarization endpoint.
- Peak TPS target: from our observability the 99th percentile of user-facing traffic is ~140 TPS, but we see two types of internal spikes: short sync jobs (up to ~370 TPS for 60–90s) and daily batch reindex windows (~220 TPS for ~6 minutes). For contract purposes, we want the platform to guarantee up to 400 TPS as the emergency burst target, but we only expect sustained production traffic to require 150 TPS.
- Budget: the $1.2k-$1.8k per 1M tokens is an internal goal, but procurement will need a clearer blended $/1M tokens that maps to a committed tier.

I'll upload the 7-day raw tps samples you asked for to the shared drive; attaching a small cropped CSV here (atlas_sample_traffic_agg.csv). Happy to set the call if you want to walk the workbook.

Sam
Head of Platform Engineering | Atlas Health AI
samuel.ortiz@atlashealth.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@atlashealth.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API — Hosted API — token bucket estimate & peak TPS follow-up

Sam — appreciate the clear numbers. A couple notes from the pricing/ops side: 

- Using 420M tokens/month and the constraint that sustained prod ~150 TPS, with emergency bursts up to 400 TPS, we recommend a two-tier approach in the hosted product: 
  * Committed monthly slab for baseline (tokens-based) sized to 420M; pricing mixes reserved vs metered for predictability.
  * Burst policy that allows short high-TPS spikes (up to configured burst ceiling) with automatic fallback to a cheaper model if burst capacity is exhausted.

- For initial commercial math we typically show a blended $/1M for the committed slab and a higher overage rate for burst traffic. Marissa — can you slot a quick scenario in the workbook showing: baseline committed at 420M, committed price target $1,400/1M, overage price $2,800/1M, and a burst credit buffer sized to sustain 400 TPS for 2 minutes?

We can convert that to a proposal doc for Procurement once Sam confirms the blended target they're comfortable with.

Karthik
Director, Solutions Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@atlashealth.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API — token bucket estimate & peak TPS follow-up

Sam / team — I added the scenario rows you asked for into redwood_pricing_scenario_v2.xlsx (tab: "Atlas_scenarios"). Quick highlights: 

- Baseline rows: 420M tokens @ $1,400/1M = list $588K/mo. With a typical PLG discount structure we can shape this to net ~$470K/mo depending on term.
- Overage: we're showing $2,800/1M. To avoid large bill volatility we recommend a 90-day rolling overage cap and an alert threshold at 60% of monthly consumption.
- Burst buffer calculation: 400 TPS sustained for 2 minutes = ~4.8M tokens (assuming avg 2 tokens/response + model tokens). I put a 10M token burst credit in the workbook to be safe.

Actionables: 
- Sam: confirm if a 10M burst credit and the 90-day overage cap are acceptable to Procurement for procurement/PO structuring.
- Neha: once we get confirmation, I’ll prepare a one-page commercial summary and initial SOW.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Pricing & Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@atlashealth.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API — token bucket estimate & peak TPS follow-up

All — confirmed. Atlas is comfortable moving forward with the following for initial proposal: 

- Committed: 420M tokens/month blended at $1,400/1M (open to term-driven discounting).
- Burst: 10M burst credit per month, with emergency burst ceiling at 400 TPS (short windows, <3 minutes).
- Overage: capped billing with the 90-day rolling cap and alerts as described.

Procurement: I’m looping our procurement lead (procurement@atlashealth.ai) to start the PO cadence. Please send the one-page commercial summary and SOW when ready.

Sam
